entry.title: New: Resolution 618 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO WAIMEA COMMUNITY ASSOCIATION FOR THE PURCHASE AND SHIPMENT OF FOUR OUTDOOR BENCHES FOR THE WAIMEA COMMUNITY

Transfers $3,784 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 1)

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 618-24 - 9/17/2024
